title: refactor(metadata-protocol): spell the inferred return types of the eight protocol.ts doors the facade keeps (.d.ts byte-equal)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgKd8GqhzWbGWABewb5SLGNm)_

domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`protocol.ts` 门面上 8 个因返回类型靠推断而留在类上的公开方法（`getDiscovery`、`findData`、`getData`、`cloneData` 和四个 `*MetaItem`）把返回类型写明在签名上，类型逐字取自它今天被推断进的 `.d.ts`；方法体一行未动。
- 为什么改：返回类型靠推断时，方法体一挪走，`.d.ts` 就会经新位置重新推断（拆分时实测 `getDiscovery` 丢过一个 `@deprecated` 注释），所以它们只能留在门面上；写明之后类型不再取决于方法体放在哪。
- 风险与回滚：没有行为变化，公开 `index.d.ts` / `index.d.cts` 改前改后逐字节相同；只有 source map 随新增行变动。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 里 `getDiscovery` 的新签名（最长的一段），再看 `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` 改了理由的 8 行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.facade-door-return-types.pin.test.ts`，预期 9 条全绿；在 main 的 `protocol.ts` 上其中 8 条是红的。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。方法体搬进 facet 这一步本 PR 没做（codemod 已不能在拆好的文件上重跑，见 Acceptance notes），`engine.ts` 那一半排在 #30055 之后。

Part of #30054 (the `protocol.ts` half, step 1 only: the return types are spelled; the bodies stay, and the `engine.ts` half is owed. Both are listed under Acceptance notes.)

Clause-②: no — the published `index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` of `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` are byte-equal before and after, so no exported member changes.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — an internal refactor of eight method signatures whose printed types do not change; no skill text names them.

## What changes

- **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`.** The eight doors the #30019 gate lists as `inferred-return-type` exceptions on card #30054 now declare their return type: `getDiscovery`, `findData`, `getData`, `cloneData`, `saveMetaItem`, `publishMetaItem`, `rollbackMetaItem`, `deleteMetaItem`. Each type is copied, text for text, from the line the base build printed for that method in `dist/index.d.ts`: the type literals, their docblocks (the `@deprecated` on `getDiscovery`'s `apiName`, the ones `publishMetaItem` carries), the double-quoted string unions and the `| undefined` the printer writes are all kept, so the declaration emit reprints them unchanged. No body, parameter or modifier changes. `tsc --noEmit` accepts every body against its spelled type.
- **`scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json`.** The eight rows stay (their bodies are still on the class, and the gate refuses a row whose member is already a delegation). Their `reason` no longer says "stays until the return type is spelled", which is now false; it says the type is spelled and why the body still stays.
- **Pin.** `protocol.facade-door-return-types.pin.test.ts` parses `protocol.ts` and requires each of the eight doors to carry a return type annotation, so an edit cannot quietly drop one before a later move would re-infer it.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch: the published declarations are byte-equal, but the shipped source maps move with the new lines, so the package's published files do change.

## Tests

- New pin: 9/9 pass at head. On `origin/main`'s `protocol.ts` (restored unstaged, then put back from `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty) 8 of 9 fail, one per door.
- Ablation (once, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): `rollbackMetaItem`'s annotation removed, anchor 1 → 0, blob `0a87e4f8` → `ec11148a`; the pin goes 1 failed / 8 passed, naming `rollbackMetaItem`; restored to the `HEAD` blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` full suite at head `1777fb2d2`: 317 files passed, 4 skipped; 22,434 tests passed, 26 skipped. `pnpm typecheck` exit 0. (The same suite ran at `63a626492`, before the second merge: 316 files, 22,419 tests, all passing.)
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) exit 0 at `63a626492`; at head `1777fb2d2`, eslint `--no-inline-config` over the two changed source files exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **The move (step 2) is not mechanical today, so it is not in this PR.** `scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs` cannot re-run on the landed facade: on `origin/main` it refuses with "protocol.ts already carries [#29985 codemod] stubs: run the script on an unsplit file". Its regenerate-from-base route no longer holds either: `--verify --base 48914fdc^` (the #29985 split's base) now reports 79/85 moved bodies identical and 71/78 host-split checks passing, because later PRs edited moved bodies in the facet modules (#30293, #30353, #30380, #30414), and two facet modules gained top-level statements that are not facet methods (`PackagedArtifactBaseType` in `protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts`, `storedGrantObjectKeys` in `protocol-package-commits.ts`), which the facade layer's unlift refuses. Moving the eight bodies needs a pass over the landed facade, as the engine codemod has (`--scoped`, `--hand-docs`, and #30055's `--members`). That is an edit to `scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs`, outside this card's file surface; carrier: the seat.
- **Rows still owed on #30054.** `protocol.ts` (body move): `getDiscovery`, `findData`, `getData`, `cloneData`, `saveMetaItem`, `publishMetaItem`, `rollbackMetaItem`, `deleteMetaItem`. `engine.ts` (types and move, serial behind #30055): `registerApp`, `registerHook`, `registerDriver`, `init`, `triggerHooks`, `destroy`, `setDatasourceMapping`, `getStatus`.
- **A spelled type is now the published shape, so it must move with the body.** TypeScript does not refuse a body that returns a wider object than its signature (a non-literal return gets no excess-property check), and the `.d.ts` prints the signature, not the body. Measured on this branch: `origin/main` gained `seedApplied.landed` on the publish receipt (#30427, `a7b8876f5`) while this PR was open; the branch's first spelling (copied at `c5800818`) merged with no conflict, and would have dropped `landed` from the published `publishMetaItem` type. The type was re-copied from `a1d0b1ee9`'s build (commit `1777fb2d2`), and the proof below is against that base. A later change to what one of these doors returns edits the signature too.
- No `packages/objectql` file changes, so its declaration files are not re-proved here.

## Verification

Head `1777fb2d2` (branch merged with `origin/main` `a1d0b1ee9`), base `a1d0b1ee9`.

<details><summary>Declaration-file proof</summary>

- Base: `origin/main` `a1d0b1ee9`'s `protocol.ts` restored into the merged tree (the merged file differs from it only by the eight annotations), `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/metadata-protocol...`, `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts` copied aside. The eight types were copied from that `index.d.ts`.
- Head `1777fb2d2`: `pnpm build` in `packages/metadata-protocol` (tsup with DTS, then `check-dts-emitted`: 2/2 declaration files present); `cmp` against the base copies: `index.d.ts` byte-equal, `index.d.cts` byte-equal (`index.d.ts` sha256 `f7c56a2155a2b77a…` on both sides).
- The same proof ran first at base `c5800818` (byte-equal, sha256 `2f93f627839cccd7…`), before the merge that brought #30427.
- The diff of the emitted declarations is empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at head `1777fb2d2`: 69 derived commands (change set: 4 paths, +251 / -16, under the 3,000 threshold). Each was run with its exit code recorded before any pipe; all 69 exit 0. `--ran` reconciles 69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed `git fetch origin 621a4876…` first (shallow clone).
- The first pass at `63a626492` (same 69 commands) had 68 exit 0 and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (no full workspace build then); at the final head it ran and passed.
- `pnpm check:facade-delegation-only`: "5 facade class(es) in 3 file(s) hold delegations only", exit 0; the registry still carries the eight rows.
- eslint over the two changed source files exit 0 at head; `pnpm lint` exit 0 at `63a626492`.

</details>
